source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of DevOps with Fig. 1.6 (PDF 15-16).

blocks.text: DevOps tareeqon (practices) ka ek set hai jo software development (Dev) aur IT operations (Ops) ko jorta hai, ta ke software products aur services dene mein mil jul kar kaam (collaboration), efficiency aur phurti (agility) barhe, jaisa Figure 1.6 mein dikhaya gaya hai. DevOps ka sab se bara maqsad development lifecycle ko chhota karna, software ki quality behtar karna aur bohat bharosay (high reliability) ke saath musalsal delivery (continuous delivery) dena hai.
DevOps kyun apnana chahiye: DevOps is liye apnana chahiye ke yeh software banane aur users tak pohanchane ke process mein bohat se faide deta hai:

items: Behtar collaboration: DevOps development aur operations teams mein mil kar kaam karne ka mahol banata hai, un ke darmiyan ki deewarein (silos, alag alag khane) torta hai aur dono teams ko ek hi maqsad par lata hai.

Market tak jaldi (Faster Time-to-Market): processes ko automate (khud kaar) kar ke aur continuous integration aur continuous delivery (CI/CD) se teams software updates aur naye features zyada tezi se de sakti hain.
Behtar quality: DevOps mein musalsal testing aur monitoring (nigrani) development cycle ke shuru mein hi masle pakar kar theek karti hai, is liye software ki quality zyada hoti hai.
Zyada efficiency: baar baar hone wale kaam automate karne se haath ki mehnat aur insani ghalti ka khatra kam hota hai, aur kaam ka bahao (workflow) zyada efficient hota hai.

blocks.alt: Infinity (laamehdood) ki shakal ka chakkar. Gehra neela Dev hissa Dev lafz ke gird plan, code, build aur test dikhata hai; hara Ops hissa Ops lafz ke gird release, deploy, Operate aur monitor. Plan aur release ki pattiyan beech mein ek doosre ko kaatti hain, is liye chakkar bina ruke chalta rehta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.6: DevOps Methodology (kitab ki Figure 1.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teeron ke rukh par chalein: plan, code, build, test (Dev, yani development team ka hissa), phir release, phir deploy, operate, monitor (Ops, yani IT operations ka hissa), aur monitor ke baad dobara plan. Infinity ki shakal batati hai ke yeh kaam ek dafa khatam nahi hota balke musalsal (continuous) chalta hai; isi ko continuous integration aur continuous delivery (CI/CD) kehte hain.

DevOps kin ke liye munasib hai: DevOps web aur mobile apps aur cloud services ke liye behtareen hai jahan tez development aur scaling (barhna) bohat zaroori hai. Misal: Amazon ka e-commerce platform DevOps se musalsal naye features aur updates jaari karta hai.

DevOps kin ke liye munasib nahi: sakht qawaneen ke paband ya hardware par munhasir (depend karne wale) projects ke liye DevOps kam munasib ho sakta hai. Misal: medical devices (tibbi aalaat) ke software ko sakht testing aur qawaneen ki paabandi (compliance) chahiye, jo DevOps ki tez raftar se shayad mel na khaye.
Waterfall ka lafz (term) sab se pehle Dr. Winston W. Royce ne 1970 mein pesh kiya tha, lekin unhon ne is ko iteration (dohrane) ke baghair istemal karne ki himayat nahi ki thi.

blocks.prompt: In mein se kaun sa DevOps ka faida nahi: (a) improved collaboration, (b) enhanced quality, (c) increased project scope creep, (d) faster time-to-market? (Exercise MCQ 6)
blocks.explanation: Option (c): scope creep ka matlab hai project ke daire (scope) ka baghair control ke phailte jana; yeh masla hai, faida nahi. Baqi teen kitab mein DevOps ke faide likhe hain. Kitab ki answer key (b) deti hai, lekin enhanced quality kitab ke text mein faida ke taur par likhi hai.

items: DevOps: development (Dev) aur IT operations (Ops) ka mel; chhota lifecycle, behtar quality, continuous delivery (Fig. 1.6).
Faide: collaboration, market tak jaldi (CI/CD), quality, efficiency. Web, mobile aur cloud (Amazon) ke liye munasib; medical devices jaise regulated projects ke liye kam.
Waterfall ka lafz Dr. Winston W. Royce ne 1970 mein diya.
